svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Share of population living in multidimensional poverty
Multidimensional poverty is defined as being deprived in a range of health, education and living standards

tspan.tspan: Alkire et al. (2025) - The Global Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI) 2025
Estimates based on the most recent household survey data (between 2013 and 2023). A separate dataset is produced to monitor trends

text.tspan: over time. Where data for 2013 is unavailable, the value from the closest year between 2014 and 2023 is shown instead.
